title: When to Plan, When to Polish: Noise Level as a Granularity Axis for Diffusion Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2606.21802v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Standard tokenwise diffusion LMs keep training corruption and inference commitment at token granularity throughout denoising. At high noise, this leaves scattered local fragments rather than coherent evidence, making it hard to form early coarse structure, exactly what planning-sensitive generation requires. Hierarchical planning methods add coarse stages to separate planning from wording, but they need extra planners, block latents, or two stage designs. We propose Noise Dependent Granularity Control (NDGC), a single-level diffusion method that uses the noise level as a granularity cue. NDGC aligns training exposure and inference commitment with denoising progress. High noise steps use coherent token groups to support early meaning commitment, while low noise steps return to token level refinement. translated_title: 何时规划，何时润色：噪声水平作为扩散语言模型的粒度轴
translated_abstract: arXiv:2606.21802v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：标准的逐词扩散语言模型在整个去噪过程中，始终在词元粒度上保持训练噪声和推理承诺。在高噪声阶段，这种处理会留下分散的局部片段，而非连贯的证据，使得难以形成早期的粗略结构——而这正是对规划敏感生成所必需的能力。分层规划方法通过增加粗粒度阶段来分离规划与措辞，但需要额外的规划器、块级潜在表示或两阶段设计。我们提出了一种噪声依赖的粒度控制（NDGC）方法，这是一种单层扩散方法，将噪声水平作为粒度线索。NDGC将训练暴露和推理承诺与去噪进度对齐：高噪声步骤使用连贯的词元组以支持早期的意义承诺，而低噪声步骤则回到词元级细化。这实现了类似规划的从粗到细的去噪过程，而无需显式规划器或分层架构。在受控测试中，该方法表现出显著优势。
tldr: 本文提出NDGC方法，通过将噪声水平作为粒度控制线索，在不增加额外规划器或分层结构的情况下，实现了从粗到细的类规划去噪，有效解决了标准逐词扩散模型在高噪声阶段难以形成早期连贯结构的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes NDGC, a single-level diffusion method that uses noise level as a granularity cue to enable coarse-to-fine denoising without explicit planners, addressing the challenge of forming coherent early structure in standard tokenwise diffusion LMs.
